name: Hub
author: Brett
description: Every axHub web page as a console screen (hub-console@1, framework/spec/HUB-CONSOLE.md): Approvals, Approval log, Passes and veto, Users, Account, Apps and connectors (with each service's detail), Handoff, Auth admin and Apps, in one Hub view with a tab-group row drawn from the route table framework/schemas/hub-console.json. Reads go through this plugin's server with the console's hub token or its own hub session; every decision (approve, deny, shelve, grant a pass, delete a user, create a token) is Brett's own tap through the approvals-banner relay, registered personOnly so no session, tool or command can run it. Every screen has a deep link (view:hub/tab:hub.tabs=<screen>), a REST read, an MCP tool, a CLI line (axf hub …) and a voice action (hub.<screen>). Settings → Plugins → Hub holds every former axHub web setting. The console is the only hub UI; axHub stays the backend and MCP hub.

keeps: The hub's own data (approvals, passes, users, services) lives on axHub and is never touched by uninstall
/projects/_shared/_data/settings/apps/axf-console.json keeps the axf.hub.* settings the migration wrote (remove them by hand if unwanted)
